rationale: Minimized cost by maximizing inverter active power output (20 MW) to reduce diesel generation to 14 MW. Set diesel reactive power to its preferred value of 4 Mvar to avoid penalty, with inverter providing remaining 8 Mvar. All constraints satisfied: P balance (14+20=34), Q balance (4+8=12), diesel limits, inverter apparent power (sqrt(400+64)=21.5<24), and voltage (0.965+0.0025*12=0.995 within [0.95,1.05]).
